title: Lineage
description: Technology-neutral definition of a player character lineage in GUMFALL. Lineages define anatomy, movement, limb layout, reattachment rules, cultural identity, and attribute tradeoffs. Body-integrity mechanics are lineage-specific — limb configurations differ across lineages.

id.description: Unique identifier. Must match one of the VERIFIED canonical lineage names in kebab-case.

name.description: Human-readable display name matching VERIFIED canonical lineage name.

anatomy.description: High-level anatomical classification describing the lineage's body plan.

movement_type.description: Primary movement modality for this lineage.

limb_layout.description: Describes the limb and appendage configuration for this lineage. Drives body-region targeting availability.

tail.description: Whether this lineage has a tail as a distinct body region.

wings.description: Whether this lineage has wings as distinct body regions.

segments.description: Number of distinct body segments (for segmented lineages like Wormkin or Ringborn).

notes.description: Additional anatomy notes for this lineage's limb layout.

reattachment_rules.description: Rules governing limb/segment detachment and reattachment. Body integrity system must honor these per Core Pillar 4 (physical consequences).

can_reattach.description: Whether detached limbs can be reattached during gameplay.

reattach_time_ms.description: Time in milliseconds required to complete reattachment (design value, NOT PERFORMED validation).

segment_independence.description: Whether detached segments can act independently (e.g., Wormkin segments).

cultural_identity.description: Cultural and narrative identity of this lineage in the world of GUMFALL.

summary.description: One to three sentence narrative summary of this lineage's place in the world.

typical_factions.description: Factions this lineage is commonly associated with.

primary_attribute_bonus.description: Attribute bonuses granted by lineage at character creation. Keys are VERIFIED primary attribute names.

tradeoffs.description: List of lineage-specific tradeoffs — things this lineage does worse or is vulnerable to.

stat.description: Optional: the stat or system affected.

equipment_accommodations.description: Special equipment rules or modifications required by this lineage's anatomy. Drives armor slot availability.

description.description: Plain-text description of the accommodation rule.
Full narrative and mechanical description of this lineage.

notes.description: Internal design notes, authority labels, or open questions.
